<!-- MENMED Website Project Instructions -->

## Project Overview
MENMED is a B2B medical equipment sales and procurement platform for healthcare facilities in Nigeria. This Vite + React + Tailwind CSS project features a professional marketing website with e-commerce capabilities.

## Technology Stack
- **Framework**: Vite + React
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **Color Scheme**: Navy Blue (#0369a1) and White
- **Responsive**: Mobile-first design with hamburger menu

## Project Structure
```
menmed-website/
├── src/
│   ├── components/
│   │   ├── Navbar.jsx
│   │   ├── HomePage.jsx
│   │   └── HeroSection.jsx
│   ├── App.jsx
│   ├── App.css
│   └── index.css
├── public/
├── index.html
├── package.json
├── vite.config.js
├── tailwind.config.js
└── postcss.config.js
```

## Setup Instructions
1. Install dependencies: `npm install`
2. Start dev server: `npm run dev`
3. Build for production: `npm run build`

## Key Features
- Professional navbar with logo and navigation links
- Hero section with CTAs and value propositions
- Stats showcase section
- Mobile-responsive hamburger menu
- Tailwind CSS for styling
